title_original: 특별검사후보추천위원회의 구성 및 운영 등에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 5 (Exclusion and Recusal of Members)
(1) A Committee member shall not participate in the Committee's deliberations where the member has a direct interest in the subject of a special prosecutor's investigation or where compelling grounds exist that would prevent impartiality.
(2) Where the Committee finds that a ground under paragraph (1) exists, it shall resolve to exclude the relevant member from deliberations.
(3) A member for whom a ground under paragraph (1) exists may, with the permission of the Chairperson, recuse himself or herself from deliberations of the Committee.
